access_boundary: This record represents the Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B-IT weight release post-trained in 2025 for Southeast Asian languages, a Gemma-3-27B-based instruct model. The Gemma base models, the base SEA-LION checkpoint, the v4.5 successor line, and independent hosts are separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated 128K-context multimodal release with SEA-language post-training and RLHF documented for eight regional languages
Weight links work and serving is available through an inference provider and HuggingChat
tradeoffs: Explicitly not safety-aligned, and vision capability is inherited from Gemma 3 rather than post-trained
Dual-layer licensing (Gemma terms for weights, MIT file for code) needs careful evidence scope
